_help: This is your editable source list. To add a source, add one item to the right list below, then save. The next run picks it up automatically. JSON has no comments, so keep the structure (commas, quotes, brackets) intact. When in doubt, ask Claude to add it for you.
_bluesky_help: Bluesky handles to watch for AI-paper buzz. We read each account's public feed (no login) and score papers by the likes+reposts on posts that link an arXiv paper. Add prolific paper-sharers here. NOTE: global search is auth-walled, so only accounts listed here are read (like the RSS list). Category bots such as arxiv-cs-cl.bsky.social give broad coverage but ~zero engagement (no buzz); the humans below are the real trending signal.
_research_filter_help: Authenticity gate (research_filter.py) runs after items are merged and before scoring. It keeps anything with a real arxiv id, drops obvious non-research (hiring/pricing/partnership/announcement) items, and sends the rest to an LLM to confirm they're backed by actual research. If ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN) is set it calls the API directly with llm_filter_model. If no key is set, it writes the undecided items to agent1_verify_queue.json for Claude Code to classify, then applies the result via: python finding_papers.py --apply-verification. Set research_filter_enabled to false to turn the gate off entirely.
